parameter.name: entryDelaySeconds
parameter.label: Entry Delay (s)
parameter.description: Seconds between zone violation and TRIGGERED in armed mode.

parameter.name: exitDelaySeconds
parameter.label: Exit Delay (s)
parameter.description: Seconds after ARM command before zones become live.

parameter.name: triggerDurationSeconds
parameter.label: Trigger Duration (s)
parameter.description: Auto-stop the siren after this many seconds (safety cap).

parameter.name: pinLockoutMinutes
parameter.label: PIN Lockout (min)
parameter.description: How long to lock the PIN entry after maxAttempts is reached.

parameter.name: reminderIntervalSeconds
parameter.label: Reminder Interval (s)
parameter.description: How often to emit a reminder audit event while TRIGGERED.

parameter.name: auditLogPath
parameter.label: Audit Log Path
parameter.description: Absolute path of the audit log file (JSON lines).

parameter.name: persistStateAcrossRestart
parameter.label: Persist State
parameter.description: Persist current state, armedAt and countdown so they survive an openHAB restart.
